calls.title: gensan thomson and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around Masterclass's budget concerns triggered by a renewal price increase from $40,500 to $160,000. Cary Rakin from Growth Book cited rapid scaling as the reason for the hike, while Matt Elgie expressed that even a smaller increase would be a challenge for their budget. Masterclass typically expects annual increases of around 10-15%. Growth Book proposed a phased pricing structure, beginning with $80,000 this year and increasing to $160,000 next year, alongside a two-year contract. Masterclass is open to adjusting user seats but aims to maintain platform usage. Both parties emphasized the importance of aligning the platform's features with Masterclass's needs, and they agreed to keep the partnership robust with future communication on feature enablement and quarterly reviews.
calls.keywords: Renewal, Pricing Negotiation, Experimentation Platform, Budget Constraints, Feature Adoption, Contract Terms
